_readme: Every number the promo page prints. `make -C promo stats` refreshes the entries marked auto from where they are measured; the rest are typed by hand and the script only tells you when it cannot check them. The page prints `text`, never `value` — so what a visitor reads is in this file verbatim. See promo/README.md.

project.since.about: First day of the project, in the hero eyebrow

labels.count.about: Human labels on the field server

labels.captures.about: Captures carrying at least one human label

labels.seconds.about: Total human-labelled call audio, in seconds
labels.seconds.source: field.db · sum of end_sec - start_sec over human labels

labels.minutes.about: The same span in minutes — the number that limits the project

context.events.about: Context events attached to labelled calls

context.tags.about: Context chips a recordist can put on a call today

context.categories.about: Groups those chips are shown in — animals, crows, food, people, quiet
context.categories.source: field.db · distinct category over active context_defs

context.tags_used.about: Chips witnessed at least once. Counts retired keys too, so it is not a subset of context.tags — the vocabulary changed and the old events kept their key.

context.tags_witnessed.about: Active chips that have actually come up at least once. The gap to context.tags is the point: the rest are options on the phone that no situation has called for yet, so the vocabulary describes what can be recorded, not what has been.
context.tags_witnessed.source: field.db · active context_defs having a context_event

context.vocabulary.text: Dog visible · Cat visible · Hawk / raptor overhead · Squirrel · Another crow arrives · Crow flies off · Group gathers · Juvenile present · Crows still, not moving · Crows agitated · Caller stayed put · Caller flew off · Human gives food · Foraging · Feeding young · Stranger approaches them · Someone they know approaches · Stranger walks past them · Someone they know walks past · Vehicle · Someone working with machinery · Someone shouting or agitated · Nothing else happening
context.vocabulary.about: The whole active chip vocabulary — key, category, English label and how often it has been witnessed. `text` is the labels joined, for prose; the structure is for anything that wants to lay them out. Event counts here are honest: context is typed by a person watching, so no seeded audio contributes.
context.vocabulary.source: field.db · context_defs joined to translations (namespace 'context', locale 'en') and counted over context_events

captures.kept.about: Genuine field recordings — the ★ Keep flag, set by hand

captures.total.about: Every capture row, mostly seeded archive clips and test uploads. A pipeline number, not a finding about crows — do not put it on the page as one.

species.heads.about: Corvid species with their own call-type head

crowtools.segments.about: Hand-reviewed one-second segments behind the clean-label AUCs

credits.recordings.about: Xeno-canto recordings CrowGPT learned from, all credited by name and ID

credits.recordists.about: People who made and shared those recordings

credits.species.about: Corvid species across the whole archive pull

crowgpt.call_types.about: Call types CrowGPT can be asked for
crowgpt.call_types.source: experiments/0021-does-the-call-type-token-do-anything/ — no manifest on disk carries the conditioned vocabulary, so this is read off the experiment

crowgpt.call_type_list.value: Alarm, generic call, flight call, begging
crowgpt.call_type_list.text: Alarm, generic call, flight call, begging
crowgpt.call_type_list.about: Those four, spelled out under the stat

auc.alarm.clean.about: Alarm call, one-vs-rest AUC on hand-reviewed labels
auc.alarm.clean.source: pipelines/ingest/, crow-tools corpus — a different measurement from pipelines/training/models/american-crow/metrics.json, which pools whole clips

auc.alarm.weak.about: Alarm call, same pipeline on the archives' free-text tags

auc.song.clean.about: Song, one-vs-rest AUC on hand-reviewed labels

auc.song.weak.about: Song, same pipeline on the archives' free-text tags
